title: The Food Coma: Why Big Meals Drop Your Battery to 1%
caption:
That after-lunch crash? Science calls it a food coma.
One cartoon guy demolishes a giant lunch, then nods off as an anatomy diagram shows his blood rerouting to his gut - a meeting later, his human battery sits at 1%.
A big meal switches on your parasympathetic 'rest and digest' system, diverting blood and energy toward digestion - that dip is the food coma.
What meal knocks YOU out every single time?
Save this for your next lunch break and follow for more body science.
